Definition: to be (causatively, make) disgusted or anxious
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be grieved, loathe, abhor, feel a loathing or abhorrence or sickening dread; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to feel a loathing at, abhor; 1a2) to feel a sickening dread; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause sickening dread; 1b2) to cause loathing
